name: Return to Lewis
summary: Dungar Longdrink sends armor from Stormwind to the People's Militia at Sentinel Hill. Osric's Crate crosses Elwynn and Westfall by gryphon, carrying supplies to defenders under pressure.

sections.title: A Lifeline by Air
sections.body: Westfall is slipping from the kingdom's grasp. Defias bandits, ravenous gnolls, and mechanical harvest reapers threaten the land. Overland supply routes face harassment, and roads are dangerous for solitary wagons. The flight master network offers a crucial lifeline. Osric, an armorer in Stormwind's Old Town, prepared a heavy crate of armor for the battered volunteers of the People's Militia at Sentinel Hill.

sections.title: The Ways of Gryphons
sections.body: Gryphons are loyal, well-trained beasts, but travel across the lands depends on established familiarity. Dungar Longdrink explains that gryphons instinctively know how to return to their capital roost in Stormwind. To carry a rider to a remote outpost, though, they need the traveler to have met its flight master in person. You have already checked in with Thor at Sentinel Hill, opening the skies over the frontier to rapid travel.

sections.title: Supplies for the Militia
sections.body: At Sentinel Hill, Quartermaster Lewis receives the crate. He is the officer tasked with outfitting Gryan Stoutmantle's volunteer force, and he sets to work distributing the armor among the frontier defenders. For Sentinel Hill, reliable aerial contact with the capital can mean the difference between holding the line and being overrun by the Defias Brotherhood.

faq.answer: Osric's Crate holds freshly made suits of armor arranged by the Stormwind armorer Osric. The People's Militia at Sentinel Hill urgently needs them; the volunteers lack standard royal provisioning and rely on donations and private shipments for their gear.

Quartermaster Lewis is the People's Militia's supply officer, stationed beside the tower at Sentinel Hill. He manages rations, gear, and arms for the volunteer defenders facing the Defias Brotherhood across Westfall.
Dungar Longdrink is Stormwind's veteran human gryphon master, at the roost in the capital's Trade District. He oversees the kingdom's aerial courier and passenger routes.

faq.q: Why do gryphons only fly to places you've already visited?
aliases: why must i visit thor first
faq.answer: Dungar says gryphons are trained to navigate straight back to the capital city. They rely on established waypoints and personal familiarity before carrying riders to remote frontier roosts like Thor's station at Sentinel Hill.
Thor is the flight master stationed at Sentinel Hill in Westfall. He tends the outpost's gryphons and receives aerial couriers from Stormwind.

faq.q: Why can't Stormwind just send royal wagons with supplies?
faq.answer: Defias bandits, riverpaw gnolls, and thieves heavily harass the roads between Elwynn Forest and Westfall. Overland supply trains risk ambush and confiscation, while the aerial gryphon route is faster and safer.

angles.text: Gryphon routes between Stormwind and outlying settlements like Sentinel Hill help bind together a kingdom that is increasingly fractured.
As a dwarf, you know gryphons as your people's ancestral mounts. The kingdom's aerial transit flies them from Dungar Longdrink's capital roost to Thor out in Westfall.
As a warrior, you know every crate of breastplates and greaves flown to Sentinel Hill gives another militia fighter a chance to withstand the blows of Defias brigands.
